standard_prerequisites.use: Derived categories of algebraic spaces, relative perfection and negativeExt vanishing, formal deformation theory and Artin representability. The local stack/diagonal/limits/Rim–Schlessinger/tangent/effectiveness chain is retained author proof rather than granted as the main conclusion.

core_obligations: Retain the actual definition and verify descent, representable diagonal and limit preservation for the stack of relatively perfect universally gluable complexes.
Use the retained local deformation, tangent-space and strong-effectiveness arguments to meet Artin representability, carrying the proper flat finitely presented family through the base reductions.

proof_roadmap.step: Retain the actual definition and verify descent, representable diagonal and limit preservation for the stack of relatively perfect universally gluable complexes.
Use the retained local deformation, tangent-space and strong-effectiveness arguments to meet Artin representability, carrying the proper flat finitely presented family through the base reductions.

difficulty_reason: The last theorem proof is a representability checklist, so its difficulty is assessed together with the retained author-local deformation/effectiveness chain. The moduli problem requires compatibility of unbounded base change with relative complexes and infinitesimal lifting, supporting H2 for the whole stated task.

compared.difference: This migrates the existing unpublished research record, not an additional count beside it.

dedup.scope: Compared fixed tag/file/claim against local manifest, same-chapter primary titles/locators, 400 retired claims, research main-overlap and preparation worklist. Related standard tools and included support are not separately counted. No remote freshness or historical novelty asserted.
